s1.text: Scores here are illustrative placeholders shaped like Martin–Quinn output, not the real values. Tenures and appointing presidents are real; the real scores come from the pipeline.

s2.text: Nearest neighbors: closest career-average score among every justice in the data set (same scale as the swarm), so a neighbor may never have overlapped. The roster then shows tenure instead of terms together, and the left chart can only highlight neighbors who overlapped.

s3.text: Bio: short Wikipedia-style summary with attribution. The copy here is my own placeholder wording, not pulled text. Roster under the swarm follows the toggle: peers who served together, or the nearest neighbors.

s4.text: Mobile: the roster shows four rows with a Show all 18 / Show fewer expander, so the page doesn't turn into an 18-row scroll. Nearest neighbors is four rows, so it never needs the expander.
